in_sanskrit.name: कृपाल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name 'Kripal' is derived from the Sanskrit word 'कृपा' (Kripā), which means 'compassion' or 'mercy'. The suffix '-al' is added to the root to denote the possessor or the doer of the quality. Thus, 'Kripal' means 'the one who is compassionate or merciful'.

in_hindi.name: कृपल
in_hindi.long_meaning: In Hindi, the name 'Kripal' translates to 'साँपत्तिक' (Sāmpattik), which means 'compassionate' or 'merciful'. This name is often given to a child who is expected to embody these qualities in his or her life.

in_tamil.name: கிற்பால
in_tamil.long_meaning: In Tamil, the name 'Kripal' translates to 'கிற்பால' (Kirpāl), which means 'one who has compassion or mercy'. This name is considered to be auspicious and is often given to a child who is expected to grow up to be a compassionate and caring individual.

data.spiritual_significance: Despite the negative connotation, the name "Kripal" can have a deeper spiritual significance in the context of the Hindu spiritual tradition. In Hindu mythology, Lord Vishnu is known to have the power of 'krpalu', or mercy and compassion. One can view the name "Kripal" as a reminder to cultivate and practice the virtue of mercy, in the face of temptation to resort to cruelty and deceitfulness. It is a call to awaken the warrior within to conquer our inner demons and sow the seeds of kindness and compassion instead.

It is frequently featured on social media platforms where parents share their naming journeys, and Hindu name websites where expectant parents research meaningful names. The name bridges traditional Hindu values with modern Indian identity, making it relevant for contemporary families seeking names with deep spiritual and cultural significance.
